html:
Queensland was a British colony in northeastern Australia, separated from New South Wales in 1859. The map shows it in 1880 and 1900, before it became a state of Australia in 1901.

Its capital, Brisbane, began in 1824 as the Moreton Bay penal settlement for convicts who had reoffended. Free settlers were allowed in from 1842. After separation, squatters drove sheep and cattle deep into the interior and up toward Cape York. Gold rushes followed at Gympie in 1867, the Palmer River in the 1870s, where thousands of Chinese miners came, and Charters Towers.

On the coast, sugar plantations used tens of thousands of Pacific Islanders, many recruited by trickery or force in what is called blackbirding. Most were deported after 1901 under the White Australia policy.

Queensland's frontier was among the most violent in Australia. The Native Police, Aboriginal troopers under white officers, carried out many killings in the frontier wars. In 1891 a great shearers' strike centred on Barcaldine helped give rise to the Labor Party, and in 1899 Queensland briefly had the world's first Labour government.
sum: Queensland was a British colony in northeastern Australia, separated from New South Wales in 1859. The map shows it in 1880 and 1900, before it became a state of Australia in 1901.
